allowed_fields: question text and canonical ID only
detector.group_id: dg: + sha256(newline-joined sorted canonical member IDs)
detector.normalization: lowercase alphanumeric tokenization only; no name stripping; no punctuation/name-specific rewriting
detector.sequence_ratio: difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, question_a, question_b).ratio() on original question text

source.upstream_commit: not present in existing metadata; immutable file content hash is authoritative

tolerance: exact frozen counts required; no positive tolerance was found in protocol v6
